observations.atomic_claim: After dispatch the runtime emits NewState only when a model field changed, the changed fields are reported in the stable order ctx, streaming_server, player, and two identical Player Loads each emit exactly one NewState.

EnvError marshals as {"code":<int>,"message":<string>} and the fixed codes Fetch=1, AddonTransport=2, Serde=3, StorageUnavailable=4, StorageSchemaVersionDowngrade=5, StorageSchemaVersionUpgrade=6, StorageReadError=7, StorageWriteError=8, Other=1001 are preserved.

The root model keeps Update(m) (whole model) and UpdateField(m, field) (single field), each returning the effects and the changed-field list; the two must produce the same effect and changed-field outputs for the same routed message.
json.Marshal of a NewState RuntimeEvent yields {"name":"NewState","args":[changed fields]} and of a CoreEvent yields {"name":"CoreEvent","args":{event...}}.

The migrated Go module provides the update/effects runtime, message and event types, Ctx and model state, player and streaming-server models, addon transports and persistence; a port missing any responsibility cannot complete a Player load and persist library/profile/dismissed-events.
deep_links generates stremio:///detail/..., /player/..., /discover/..., /addons/..., /library..., /calendar/..., /search?... with the engine query-parameter encoding.

The Go module exposes the equivalent public surface of the addon_transport, analytics, deep_links, models, runtime and types packages, including the model construction/derivation entry point models.New(env).
Action values marshal with action/args, Event values with event/args, and model-load actions with model/args.
No required public capability (runtime, models, addon transports, deep links, analytics, persistence) is removed or has its contract changed outside the stated goal.
New(model Model, effects []Effect, buffer int, env Env) returns a *Runtime together with a <-chan RuntimeEvent; a port without the initial-effect list or the event receiver fails.
An internal message updates the model and continues processing returned effects, an event message emits only a CoreEvent, and an action returned by an effect panics.

The legacy transport keeps its JSON-RPC wire protocol and maps a JSON-RPC error to an addon-transport error formatted rpc error {code}: {message}, and keeps existing unsupported-resource/request messages.
Loadable and ResourceLoadable keep their loading/ready/error states and emit changed-field notifications when Env::fetch succeeds or fails.
The migrated tests keep their assertions and comparisons and derive inputs from the model rather than hardcoding expected outputs.
Runtime.Model() returns the current model, and Dispatch(RuntimeAction{Field,Action}) routes a present Field to UpdateField and an absent Field to whole-model Update.
The legacy transport base64-encodes the JSON-RPC body into {transport_url}/q.json?b=<param> and deserializes {"result": ...} and {"error": {"message": ..., "code": ...}} responses.
The Env interface keeps fetch, get_storage, set_storage, exec_concurrent, exec_sequential, now, local_now and the analytics operations (FlushAnalytics, AnalyticsContext).
